vb_textbox.text: Try taking note of the number of mushrooms each colour gives, there is a pattern to them being the higher reward. Keep an eye out though as this does change throughout the game. I kept in mind the gnomes that were giving the higher rewards and stuck with those colours until the pattern changed. Once one changed I would also try the other gnome colours in other rounds, this worked quite well. Keep focused with your eyes on the mushrooms and best of luck!
